title: horizon
intro:
A ‘horizon’ is a soil type with specific physical properties. It is the responsibility of
the ‘horizon’ component to specify these properties.
    Used by SoilLayer @ horizon (see 107.19, page 612) , and SoilRegion @ horizon
(see 107.20, page 613) .
   < component (HorHeat HorHeat )                                    ; Has default value.
                     (hydraulic hydraulic )                          ; Default hypres value.
                     (tortuosity tortuosity )                        ; Default linear value.
                     (C per N C per N )
                     (anisotropy 1 [])
                     (dry bulk density dry bulk density )
                     (quartz quartz )
                     (SOM C per N 11 11 11)
                     (SOM fractions SOM fractions ...)
                     (turnover factor 1 [])
                     (root homogeneity 1 [])
                     (root retardation 1 [])
                     (K factor 1 [])
                     (Nitrification Nitrification )                  ; Default soil value.
                     (secondary domain secondary domain ) ; Default none value.
                     (attributes)
                     (r pore min 0.1 [um])
                     (CEC CEC ) >

    HorHeat: HorHeat fixed component (see section 107.18)
     Submodel (has fully specified default value)
     Heat capacity and conductivity.

    hydraulic: hydraulic component (see chapter 48)
     Component (default ‘hypres’)
     The hydraulic propeties of the soil.

    tortuosity: tortuosity component (see chapter 90)
     Component (default ‘linear’)
     The soil tortuosity.

    C per N : number [g C/g N]
     Optional parameter
     Total C/N ratio for this horizon. This is the combined initial C/N ratio for
     all organic matter pools in the horizon. The C/N ration of the AOM and
     SMB pools is assumed to be known, given that this number is used to find the

        common C/N ration for the SOM pools. The C/N ration for the SOM pools
        will then gradually move towards the values specified by ’SOM C per N’. By
        default, the values given by ’SOM C per N’ will be used for initialization.

       anisotropy: number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 1)
        Horizontal saturated water conductivity relative to vertical saturated water
        conductivity. The higher this value, the faster the water will move towards
        drain pipes.

       dry bulk density: number [g/cm3 ]
        Optional parameter
        The soils dry bulk density. By default, this is calculated from the soil con-
        stituents.

       quartz : number [<fraction>]
        Optional parameter
        Fraction of quartz in soil minerals. By default, this is calculated from the
        soil constituents. quartz = clay * 0.15 + silt * 0.6 + sand * 0.7 See also
        [Møberg et al., 1988]

       SOM C per N : number [g C/g N] sequence
        Parameter (has default value with length 3)

        (SOM_C_per_N 11 11 11 [g C/g N])

        Parameter description:
        C/N ratio for each SOM pool in this soil. If ’C per N’ is specified, this is used
        as a goal only. If ’C per N’ is unspecified, the SOM pools will be initialized
        with this value.

       SOM fractions: number (dimensionless) sequence
        Optional parameter
        Fraction of humus in each SOM pool, typically slow, fast and inert. Negative
        numbers mean unspecified, let Daisy find appropriate values.

       turnover factor : number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 1)
        Factor multiplied to the turnover rate for all organic matter pools in this
        horizon.

       root homogeneity: number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 1)
        Factor multiplied to the root density of all crops in this horizon. The idea is
        to emulate the effect of roots not being distributed evenly in the soil.

       root retardation: number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 1)
        Factor multiplied to root penetration speed.

       K factor : number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 1)
        Factor multiplied to the hydraulic conductivity.

       Nitrification: nitrification component (see chapter 58)
        Component (default ‘soil’)
        The soil nitrification process.

    secondary domain: secondary component (see chapter 78)
     Component (default ‘none’)
     Secondary matrix domain for solute movement.

    attributes: submodel (see section 4.1.7) sequence
     Optional submodel (default: an empty sequence)
     List of additional attributes for this horizon. Intended for use with pedotrans-
     fer functions.

        <    key value     >

        – key: string (see section 4.1.5)
          Parameter
          Name of attribute.

        – value: number [<user>]
          Parameter
          Value of attribute.

    r pore min: number [um]
     Parameter (default 0.1)
     Smallest pores in the soil.

    CEC : number [cmolc/kg]
     Optional parameter
     Cation-Exchange Capacity.By default this will be calculated from a pedo-
     transfer function based onDanish cultivated soils. The pedotransfer function
     is known to be invalidfor podzolic B-horizons. See also [Krogh et al., 2000]

sections.name: BSI3
sections.desc: A horizon using BSI3 texture classification.
sections.sig:
< BSI3        (clay clay )
                (silt silt )
                (sand sand )
                (humus humus )
                (chalk 0 [<fraction>])
                (normalize false)
                (other 0 [<fraction>])
                ;; Shared parameters are described in chapter 47.
                (HorHeat HorHeat )                   ; Has default value.
                (hydraulic hydraulic )               ; Default hypres value.
                (tortuosity tortuosity )             ; Default linear value.
                (C per N C per N )
                (anisotropy 1 [])
                (dry bulk density dry bulk density )
                (quartz quartz )
                (SOM C per N 11 11 11)
                (SOM fractions SOM fractions ...)
                (turnover factor 1 [])
                (root homogeneity 1 [])
                (root retardation 1 [])
                (K factor 1 [])
                (Nitrification Nitrification )       ; Default soil value.
                (secondary domain secondary domain ) ; Default none value.
                (attributes)
                (r pore min 0.1 [um])
                (CEC CEC ) >

attrs.name: normalize
attrs.doc:
If this is true, normalize the mineral fraction to 1.0. Otherwise, give an error
        if the sum is not 1.0.

attrs.name: other
attrs.doc:
Other soil components. Typically larger mineral components (stones, peb-
        bles). These will be ignored by Daisy, but can be included here to ensure the
        sum is 1.0.
